pages.heading: Using the field notes
pages.body: Alex's Mobs adds wildlife across the Overworld, Nether and End. Some creatures are threats; others offer transport, materials or useful interactions. Habitats follow the mod's normal distribution, but KNCraft's biome mix affects where you

pages.heading: Using the field notes (cont.)
pages.body: find them. Consult the $(l:patchouli:chapters/catalog#animals_index)Mob catalog$(/l) for species-specific handling, food and drops.

pages.heading: Keeping animals
pages.body: Give predators and prey separate spaces. Transport aquatic creatures in the appropriate bucket and keep food-stealing wildlife away from open storage. Use the ingredient the entry names. Two mods can add fruit with similar

pages.heading: Keeping animals (cont.)
pages.body: names without making them interchangeable. Check JEI and item tooltips before spending a rare supply. Test travel with one companion before attempting to evacuate a whole collection.

pages.heading: Trust, taming and breeding
pages.body: Taming, breeding and temporary trust are different. A creature that accepts food is not necessarily a permanent companion. Check its catalog entry before approaching, and carry the supplies needed to care for it. The mod's Animal

pages.heading: Trust, taming and breeding ...
pages.body: Dictionary remains useful alongside this guide; the catalog here brings the practical notes into one place.

pages.text: Next chapter first; previous chapter below.

pages.heading: Prepare for travel
pages.body: $(l:patchouli:chapters/architecture#wildlife)KNCraft Architecture$(/l) connects farming, cooking, clothing, tents and portals. Read the new chapter for optional survival recipes, default effects and safe travel. Use /kncraft status to check enabled features.
